reviews.author: M Bankson
reviews.text:
Don’t rent an ATV if you plan to drive off road to get to secluded beaches etc!!!! Outside that situation this place is perfectly fine and nice people.

It says in the fine print of the rental contract that you are not allowed to take ATVs off paved roads but we did not see this, drove on a dirt road, and ended up getting a flat tire in a very inconvenient remote location. We should have read the fine print, but having not done so we perhaps sort of understandably made a mistake in assuming we could take all terrain vehicles, well, on all terrains. After the customer service lady yelled at us a lot on the phone while we were already hot and stressed out, lol, they were able to send someone fairly quickly to pick up the ATV.

We ended up paying an expensive repair fee which was a bummer but fair enough since we were in breach of contract. We totally acknowledge that we did something wrong in not reviewing the rules carefully but also this would have been avoided if someone took 15 seconds to say “hey you actually can’t take this any of the places you are specifically renting this type of vehicle to go to.” We never would have done this if we knew that stipulation.

So I am leaving this review so other people don’t get in this situation! Don’t be like me!!! Idk how you’re supposed to get to Faneromeni or other more far flung natural beaches when it’s super hot out if you don’t own a car but maybe just go to some of the closer ones on the paved roads or take the bus. I hear boat tours go to these places but ours got canceled due to wind.

reviews.text: απαράδεκτη εξυπηρέτηση από το τηλεφωνικό κέντρο
reviews.ownerReply: You went with a small ATV on a place which is extremely bad road. We are locals and we never go there. So you decided to go there then you couldn’t come back and asked for help. The signal is very bad on that spot and it’s also prohibited for any vehicle to get there. You still decide to make one star on a family business. What was the service you wanted from the call Center? To say thank you that you took our vehicle on a place impossible to retrieve? The call center  immediately replied and tried to organise your stupid rescue.

reviews.author: Lenzo Canto
reviews.text: Ne pas y aller. De manière générale, les employés ne sont pas tellement voire pas du tout aimables, à la limite respectueux. Nous avons loué 4 vélos pour la demi journée à 15€ le vélo ( 60€ pour une demi journée en VTT normal…). De plus, si vous louez des vélos ne vous attendez pas à ceux exposés devant l’entrée du magasin puisque nous nous sommes retrouvés avec des vélos rouillés, en état correct seulement et des freins douteux. En bref, évitez cette adresse !

reviews.author: Mahe Canto
reviews.text:
Adresse à éviter, nous avons louer pour 60€ 4 vélos pendant 1/2 journée. Ceux-ci étaient rouillés au niveau de la chaîne ce qui a provoqué de nombreux déraillements. La selle n’est pas du tout adapté pour de longues sorties, même des courtes à vrai dire… bref l’opposé des vélos exposés devant la vitrine.
De plus, les employés n’ont pas été accueillant, à la limite du non respect.
Ne pas y aller !!!

reviews.author: C. Cgnt
reviews.text: ATTENTION ARNAQUE !!! Le monsieur qui accueille est d'une impolitesse et désinvolture affligeante ! Après m'avoir demandé exactement où je comptais me rendre sur l'île (interrogatoire poussé digne d'un agent du FBI ! Sérieusement, de quoi je me mêle ??!) il m'a dit qu'il me louerait un scooter seulement si je me rends à certains endroits et pas d'autres (hallucinant tout de même et surtout invérifiable, donc sacrément stupide !). Tout comme sa voisine, il a voulu m'arnaquer. Sauf que c'était ma 3e location de scooter durant mon séjour donc je connaissais parfaitement les prix et conditions. Je n'étais sur Antiparos que pour 2 ou 3 heures et il a proposé de me louer un scooter pour le prix d'une journée entière !!! Honteux ! Surtout que c'est la fin de la saison. Il a totalement gâché mon après-midi sur Antiparos. Je n'ai pu que me balader à pied dans le secteur nord ! Écœurant un tel comportement !!! Quand on travaille dans le tourisme déjà on apprend l'amabilité, la politesse, le sens de l'accueil (et non de l'arnaque !) sinon on change de métier !!!!! Il y a 2 autres agences bien + sympa vers qui vous pourriez vous diriger un peu plus éloignée mais de 5 min. Dimitri + 1 autre qui est à côté d'une agence de plongée. Je les ai eu par téléphone, je n'ai pas pu louer car ils avaient clôturé leur saison. Mais ils m'ont très gentiment renseigné sur ce qui se fait et ne se fait pas en termes de tarifs... ! Tournez-vous plutôt vers eux.
reviews.ownerReply: Thank you for your review! You can’t go everywhere with the scooter that means you can’t go to rocky roads or any place without asphalt. Please consider that all the prices are daily based and there is not such thing like hourly rentals also Licence is MANDATORY to rent here in Greece we can’t rent you a scooter without license. The price is for the service provided and the questions are to understand your needs and help you experience the best way possible. None of these businesses are scam. All of them are local family businesses who operate more than 30 years. We would love to offer our services to you but not free🙏 Thanks for your understanding

reviews.author: Rok Čož
reviews.text: Very arrogant and completely unnecessarily disrespectful employee. The bike was very unstable compared to other bikes we rented that week. Would not recommend.
reviews.ownerReply: Dear Rok, thank you for your feedback. We're sorry to hear about your experience, as this is not the level of service we aim to provide. Your comments regarding both our staff and the bike are taken seriously and will be carefully reviewed. We would appreciate the chance to welcome you again and provide you with a better experience.

reviews.author: Laia Sol
reviews.text: Scammers. We went there because we read on the reviews it costed 40€, once there, they asked 60-70€, after saying that’s not what we read, asked for 50€ saying that is because it’s “high season like the hotels” mam, high season doesn’t start the 1st of August, so for 1 day we have to pay more? You can’t expect anything good from people who tries to scam you.
reviews.ownerReply: Thanks for your review. We are a family business operating since 1994. The prices change according to the demand.  Our full season is only few days in the summer . The prices were clear if you need to rent something you are free to rent it. But I don’t believe that we deserve one star just because you didn’t like the price and you never tried our ATVs.

reviews.author: denis bourcier
reviews.text: Unbelivable... many quad and scooter for rent but they don't want to rent for half day!
reviews.ownerReply: We have reservations waiting to be picked up. One star without trying our services is not fair.

reviews.author: calie bourcier
reviews.text: Nul !!!!! Nous avons pris contact avec eux 1 semaine avant d’aller à anti-paros en leur indiquant l’âge de chaque personne. Ils nous on dit que c’était pas possible de réserver des vélos mais sur places les louer oui. On arrive le matin pour louer les vélos ils nous renvoient en disant qu’ils ont des vélos pour enfants mais qu’ils veulent pas nous les loués car 10 ans est trop petit, alors qu’on leur avait indiqués l’âge des enfants 1 semaine à l’avance et ils nous avaient rien dit. Et en milieu d’après-midi on y retourne pour louer des scooters ils nous disent qu’ils en ont pas alors qu’il y en avait pleins juste devant le magasin. Je recommande absolument pas. Ils ne veulent pas travailler ni louer ! Si j’aurais pu mettre 0 étoiles je l’aurais fais 😡
reviews.ownerReply: It’s full season anything you will need has to be reserved and it’s really dangerous to go with the small children’s on the road with bicycles. We make reservations only for cars scooters and ATVs. Bicycles we reserve only for a week or more and this only if it’s low season. The scooters are all rented out you might see them outside but someone has already paid deposit for it. We have the obligation to wait for them even if they never arrive. Please stop complaining and making one star reviews to family businesses

reviews.author: Elena Katsanou
reviews.text: The worst Rent a car store in Antiparos. The owner doesn't know how to do his job, he doesn't want to work, he doesn't know the availability of his own vehicles, generally he doesn't have idea of anything. Stay away if you want to stay in good mood in Antiparos. Also don't try to call because there is only a cellphone number which answers a housewife from her house and never can help you.
reviews.ownerReply:
Thanks for your review! Last minute reservations are hard to be done especially if our clients don’t know what is the best for them to get the best experience of the island. We would be happy to help you if you know how many days you need a vehicle and the type of vehicle you drive.
We are currently 30 years in this business and still counting working with the best hotels in the Island. Thanks again

reviews.author: Todd Johnson
reviews.text: Rude employee (I think was a son), our bikes we rented broke about half an hour into the day and we called to let them know and it took an hour for them to come out, they couldn’t replace the bikes and laughed in our face when asking for a refund and was told he “doesn’t care that we wasted our time”, refusing to give a refund and threatened to leave us out on the side of the road with no bikes and drive off. Terrible service.
reviews.ownerReply: Our colleagues replaced your bikes the soonest possible. You decided you wanted a refund after half day rental. The refund was done. You used the bikes for free you made damage to the gear system which we didn’t even charge and still make a review. We accept all the reviews bad and good but it’s a family business we have to survive and we can’t if we lose time to get you a new bike so that you continue your trip and you want a full refund. Have nice holidays and try to be fair🙏

reviews.author: Leelou Cheynet
reviews.text: Voitures de dépannage grâce à notre charmant hôte mais voitures chères, en mauvais état et en plus nous avons dû payer en cash... on était contents d'avoir une voiture mais ça vaccine!!!
reviews.ownerReply: Thanks for your review but we don’t remember any issue or a mechanical fault in any of our cars for the last 3 years. Are you sure that you rented from our family business? Could you please be more specific

reviews.author: Edvin Østvik
reviews.text:
Whatever you do, do not rent electric bikes from this business. Heard rumors about cheap bikes with appalling technical standard from several friends. Got this confirmed by family member who rented two bikes here. Bad brakes and low battery capacity. Unrespectful communication with the owner when they tried to deliver a complaint and suggest compensation.

I’ve been a customer here earlier, but only rented cars and ATVs. Always satisfied. It is strange to see that this company treats customers this way both in communication and lousy products when it comes to electric bikes.

Edit: As I wrote, I’m not the one who rented the bikes and this was the third incident I heard of since coming to the island about cheap bikes with low battery capacity.

Extra free day as compensation when you already had a bad experience? Just sad.
reviews.ownerReply:
Thanks for your review. We handed over the ebikes to you in good condition early in the morning. We gave you our phone number in case anything at all that happens to phone straight away and we come to help you. We tried our best but you brought the ebikes in the end of the day not in the same condition as you received it, and just started to complain. We didnt receive any phone call in the midday to change your ebikes. We offered to you to come and ride ebikes the next day for free but all you wanted was compensation. I feel like that if all our clients were like this we couldn't afford to work this business anymore. Our offer for you still works though. You could ride two ebikes for free one day.
Thanks for your review and your understanding.

reviews.author: Franck TARTIVEL
reviews.text:
Loueur a eviter a tout prix
Une famille Grec de voleur qui est capable de vous vendre et louer n'importe quoi tant qu'ils  prennent le cash
À fuir
reviews.ownerReply: Thanks for your review! We are indeed a hardworking family business! We accept all payment methods! We hope you find out what you are looking for!

reviews.author: Paraskevi Spyrou
reviews.text:
Μεταβήκαμε τυχαία στο κατάστημα και η αντιμετώπιση των υπευθύνων ήταν απρόσμενα προσβλητική. Ζητήσαμε πληροφορίες για την κατάσταση των δρόμων στο νησί σχετικά με την ποδηλασία (αφού ήταν η πρώτη φορά που το επισκεπτομασταν) και ακολούθησαν αλλεπάλληλες ειρωνικές και αγενείς εκφράσεις όπως : "τι ερωτήσεις είναι αυτές ΡΕ κορίτσι μου", "αν φοβάσαι κάτσε σπίτι και κοιμησου" κλπ. Οι λοιπές αρνητικές αξιολογήσεις επιβεβαιώνουν πως η εξυπηρέτηση από το συγκεκριμένο κατάστημα είναι επιεικώς απαράδεκτη.

My friend and I entered the store by chance and the managers/employees were unexpectedly rude, bordering on the offensive. Since this was our first time on the island, we enquired about the state of the roads and the accessibility of beaches. In response to our questions, we received multiple belittling and demeaning answers, such as "what kind of question is that little girl?" "if you're afraid (of cycling on the island) you should stay home and sleep" etc. The other negative reviews of this particular establishment confirm the absolutely unacceptable level of customer service offered.

reviews.author: charly price
reviews.text: The shop rented me a terrible bicycle where the gears did not work. I’d never rent from them again.
reviews.ownerReply: We feel sorry for your experience. By the time our bicycles leave the garage the gears are always tested. It would be better to inform us for any issue with the bike so that we can replace it or fix it immediately and not use the bicycle for the whole day without gears. Thanks for your review

reviews.author: jeanlouis carrera
reviews.text:
Accueil assez sympathique mais fin de journée vraiment détestable 2 quads loués 2 quads en panne en fin de journée
Obligés de les ramener nous-mêmes car personne n’a répondu au téléphone en plus accueil désagréable au retour
Prix largement au dessus du continent
A fuir absolument

We believe that your review is not fair like you broke the contract by letting your kids drive instead of you

reviews.author: foraw forma
reviews.text: Dont ever rent from this he is verry rude, his son is descent  but the father is verry bad and all bikes are almost broken!
reviews.ownerReply:
I think you should first rent a vehicle in order to leave a review

Thank you anyway

reviews.author: Cristina Bertolano
reviews.text: Less rude in treating the customers. Rental terms shall be clear since the beginning. We have been compelled to pay the full amount at the starting of the rental period even if there was no mention at the time of the booking of the service. We always spend our vacation in greece and this is the first time we had a so bad esperience of this inusual rudeness.
reviews.ownerReply: The rental terms are always clear and we have never been rude to anyone. We offer our services the best way we can without reserving amount from our customers' credit card unlike other agencies. Thanks a lot for you comment we will continue to improve

reviews.author: Kendra McQuarrie
reviews.text: Rented a car from them and enjoyed the experience until the battery died multiple times. We called the woman who rented us the vehicle yo let her know and she told us to return it, which we did. Shortly after we returned teje car and keys upon her wish, we got a call from the women named Marouso and she threatened to “meet you at the airport tomorrow and kill you”, called us “stupid idiots” and said we “killed her car” when in fact she rented us a very old vehicle with a dead battery that we had to fix ourselves. DO NOT GO HERE. This women is crazy, don’t think I’ve ever been more appalled at such terrible customer service, and I’m honestly afraid after her death threats.
reviews.ownerReply:
I feel very sorry for your disappointment. We take our business very seriously and respect our customers the way we respect our family. Therefore we would never disrespect a customer, as our goal is to help you create a great experience. In my defense I found it rather absurde to leave a bad review mentioning a death threat about a car battery, I think you could find a better excuse.

Please note that the 500€ damage caused to the car was disregarded before writing this

Thank you

reviews.author: Marlon Perez
reviews.text: Zero concept of customer appreciation and respect. Rented a sad excuse for a car that had major issues and was absolutely filthy. Paid for a whole day at 1pm and was told to return the car by 8 after being told it was a whole day lease. Ended up having extreme car issues and was blamed for them. Do not rent from here, especially when there are other trustworthy, respectful and appreciative rental companies on the same strip.

reviews.author: Madelaine Perez
reviews.text: These people are crooks. Should’ve read the reviews before renting from this place. We lost a large part of our day due to malfunctions with the vehicle battery and was insulted  when we let them know about the issues and blamed us saying we didn’t know how to drive. For your safety and the safety of others please stay far far away from this place.

reviews.author: Fred B
reviews.text:
Leurs quads ne sont pas bien entretenus. J'ai été bloqué avec mes deux enfants sur une plage car un des deux quads refusait de démarrer.  En plus quand je les ai appelé,  je me suis fait insulter. J'ai dû me débrouiller seul. Jamais vu cela en Grèce où les gens sont si aimables et courtois. A éviter. ....il y en a plein d'autre loueur juste à coté .
Their atv don't work well. I was stuck on a beach with my two children because one atv's engine didn't start. When I called them, they insulted me. I had to solve the problem by myself. Don't rent them anything.
reviews.ownerReply:
Dear Mr. Fred
Morning time you came to the store to rent two atvs. You didn't know how to drive an atv so we taught you how! The beach you were is called monastiria the worst road of the island. No one usually goes there because it is very dangerous hill. We were surprised that you went there with your two children  with the atvs. The hill is very steep that's why the one atv 50cc banged fuel that's why you could not start it immediately. By the time you called us the store was full of people because it is full season. Although we told you to try to start the atv alone because we knew the problem by the time you told us you were at monastiria. We knew that the atv would start after some effort. We also sent a white van to come for you (we sent you a message about it). By the time the white van was getting down the hill you were going up already with the atvs. We are really sorry about what happened to you but people usually are afraid to go at that beach with small 50cc atvs.
